header: Step 2: Create a domain with Cognito authentication
content:
Navigate to the Amazon OpenSearch Service console at https://console.aws.amazon.com/aos/
home/ and create a domain with the following settings:
• OpenSearch 1.0 or later, or Elasticsearch 7.8 or later
• Public access
• Fine-grained access control enabled with MasterUserRole as the master user (created in the
previous step)
• Amazon Cognito authentication enabled for OpenSearch Dashboards. For instructions to enable
Cognito authentication and select a user and identity pool, see the section called “Conﬁguring a
domain to use Amazon Cognito authentication”.
• The following domain access policy:
JSON
{
"Version":"2012-10-17",
"Statement": [
{
"Effect": "Allow",
"Principal": {
"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root"
},
"Action": [
"es:ESHttp*"
],
"Resource": "arn:aws:es:us-east-1:111122223333:domain/{domain-name}/*"
}
]
}
• HTTPS required for all traﬃc to the domain
• Node-to-node encryption
• Encryption of data at rest
